title: Lab-series date boxes may draw no focus ring in WebKit, the H78 fault class
evidence: From PR 1627 (US-62 AC10b). WebKit never matches :focus-visible on input[type=date], and Chromium misses it after Shift+Tab; :focus-within matches in both. AC10b fixed only the value page's .md-add Add form. Same class, not checked: widget-src/src/components/AddLabTest.tsx:262 (.alr-add-date) and widget-src/src/components/DraftDateCell.tsx:57. Read their computed outline on Tab and Shift+Tab in real WebKit first; if the ring is missing, give the date box the ring on :focus-within. Done: live WebKit read the lab date box and the DraftDateCell buttons as outline none (WebKit Tab stops on the cell's hidden date input); PR 1627's rule now covers .alr-add-form inputs and .bt-cell-draft-date / .bt-cell-movable on :focus-within; two advisory gate probes in tools/webkit-focus-probes.mjs. (H89)
